descriptors.R: nominee of the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 1994 elections; a sitting governor of a large Southern state
descriptors.D: the sitting Vice President, nominee of the party that has held the White House since 1993
descriptors.O: third-party nominee, a consumer advocate campaigning against corporate influence over both major parties

compile_desc.R: the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 1994 elections
compile_desc.D: the party that has held the White House since 1993

others_line: Other candidates on most ballots, including a Reform party and a Libertarian nominee (answer "other").
never_name: Bush, Gore, Cheney, Lieberman, Clinton, McCain, Bradley, Nader, Buchanan, LaDuke, Harry Browne or Lewinsky

slice_sources.men: 2000 census (April; SF1/SF3 via NHGIS) aged to November 2000 along the 1990→2000 trend; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2000); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2000 returns.
slice_sources.women: 2000 census (April; SF1/SF3 via NHGIS) aged to November 2000 along the 1990→2000 trend; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2000); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2000 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 2000 census (April; SF1/SF3 via NHGIS) aged to November 2000 along the 1990→2000 trend; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2000); calibrated to the certified 2000 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 2000 census (April; SF1/SF3 via NHGIS) aged to November 2000 along the 1990→2000 trend; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2000), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 2000 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 2000 census (April; SF1/SF3 via NHGIS) aged to November 2000 along the 1990→2000 trend; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the congressional majority party
